title: Preventive Actions Following Power Failure of 26 January 2019
what_it_is: Preventive Actions Following Power Failure of 26 January 2019

sections.label: Bright Hill substation equipment fault
sections.summary: EMA preliminary investigations found the disruption was likely due to an equipment fault at a Bright Hill substation, a faulty voltage transformer that started a fire.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Based on the Energy Market Authority's (EMA's) preliminary investigations, the disruption was likely due to an equipment fault at a substation at Bright Hill.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The suspected cause is a faulty voltage transformer which started a fire in the substation.

sections.label: Power restoration and grid reliability
sections.summary: SPPG restored supply to 80% of consumers within 30 minutes and the rest within 90 minutes, and has adopted higher frequency condition monitoring and prioritised component replacement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: SP Power Grid (SPPG), the national grid operator, was able to restore supply to 80% of consumers within 30 minutes and fully restored power supply to the remaining 20% of consumers within 90 minutes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This is the first power failure incident involving a faulty voltage transformer in the past five years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Over the past six years, Singapore's average annual disruption per consumer ranged from 12 seconds to 4.2 minutes, which includes the most recent incident.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In comparison, major cities, such as Osaka, New York, Hong Kong and London, experienced an average disruption per consumer of between five minutes and 21 minutes in financial year 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: SPPG has since adopted a higher frequency of condition monitoring for the specific equipment that had failed and will prioritise the replacement of that particular component in future rounds of substation maintenance.

sections.label: Round-the-clock network monitoring protocol
sections.summary: SPPG's distribution control and customer service monitors and controls the distribution network around the clock, and supply can generally be restored within three hours.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As far as protocol to ensure that our system is robust and resilient, let me just share that SPPG's distribution control and customer service monitors and controls the distribution network around the clock to ensure that electrical supply can be restored quickly in the event of power supply disruption to our consumers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And supply could generally be restored typically within three hours by switching to an alternate feed or deployment of mobile generators.
